embeds.title: ⏱️ Timing Briefing · Nov 24
embeds.description:
**Verdict**
• **The slide has paused.** The market price index has sat at 86-88 for 4 days after falling from ~123 at launch. Holding stock for 1-3 days no longer loses value by default.
• **Daily supply wave:** listings peak ~53k around 8-9 PM local and drop to ~38k by 6-8 AM. Buy into the evening glut, post late morning when shelves are thin.
• **Clock cycles per item are not reliable.** Prices jump on dumps and buyouts. The repeatable play is: buy a dump, relist at the floor the item has held recently.

fields.name: Tested and dropped
